newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa trust buys 25.9 pct of IB Joffe.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa trust buys 25.9 pct of IB Joffe.

text.p: The Neil Bernstein Family Trust has bought a 25.89 percent stake in IB Joffe Ltd at 50 cents a share and with effect from July 1, IB Joffe said on Thursday.
It said that the trust had bought the interest as it had identified IB JOffe as a trading business with strong export prospects, particularly in Africa.
IB Joffe siad both it and the family trust had call and put otions respectively to purchase and/or sell:
- a further 2.984 million shares, respresenting 16.79 percent of the issued share capital at 50 cents a share at any time from January 1, 1988 to January 5, 1998;
- and 7.46 million shares constituting about 41.98 percent of the share capital at 60 cents each in the period June 1, 1988 to June 25 1998.
